cs.t: Thank you. Yeah, the maslow is ingenious. I love the idea and the approach, though it doesn't do well with odd shapes or fixtures. I think of it more as a sheet cutter than a CNC router, just because it doesn't really have the ability to navigate non-flat surfaces. I think a maslow style would be really great for a plasma cutter.
